e1c9a4nf1riia.text: Far at the back, beneath a golden parasol, was the king. He was too far away for you to see his face.
e1c9a4nf1riia.heard: Far at the back, beneath a golden parasol, was the king. He was too far away for you to see his face.

e16sh3fa13zde.speaker: narr
e16sh3fa13zde.text: In front of the stone tablet, a priest read out in a loud voice the king's wish, carved in the inscription.
e16sh3fa13zde.heard: In front of the stone tablet, a priest read out in a loud voice the king's wish, carved in the inscription.

e6cl40n17e7b.speaker: 祭官
e6cl40n17e7b.text: “May my mother be freed from the ocean of rebirth and reach Buddhahood.”
e6cl40n17e7b.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e3gryck3cuws.speaker: sreymom
e3gryck3cuws.text: …The king thinks of his mother this much, too.

e1dvzfg4dwnr9.speaker: narr
e1dvzfg4dwnr9.text: Evening. Torches were lit in the galleries.
e1dvzfg4dwnr9.scene: お祝いの、晴れやかな場面。明るく

eirn86np81dx.speaker: narr
eirn86np81dx.text: The sound of drums, xylophones and flutes. The dancers opened their hands slowly, so slowly.
eirn86np81dx.heard: The sound of drums, xylophones and flutes. The dancers opened their hands slowly, so slowly.

e77pfco6gtz1.speaker: narr
e77pfco6gtz1.text: Sreymom was among them. Her hands were no longer shaking.
e77pfco6gtz1.scene: お祝いの、晴れやかな場面。明るく

e1x6rvv41j3ym.speaker: nekmax
e1x6rvv41j3ym.text: …We're back. This is Ta Prohm today.
e1x6rvv41j3ym.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

eyztq68mjkgc.speaker: nekmax
eyztq68mjkgc.text: Look how the huge tree roots wrap around the stone galleries, as if they're swallowing them. After the temple stopped being used, the forest came back, over hundreds of years.
eyztq68mjkgc.heard: Look how the huge tree roots wrap around the stone galleries, as if they're swallowing them. After the temple stopped being used, the forest came back, over hundreds of years.
eyztq68mjkgc.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1jq6tfk1rl9p.speaker: nekmax
e1jq6tfk1rl9p.text: It was decided to keep this temple as close as possible to how it looked when it was found, so the trees were left as they were. Today, people from India and Cambodia are restoring it together.
e1jq6tfk1rl9p.heard: It was decided to keep this temple as close as possible to how it looked when it was found, so the trees were left as they were. Today, people from India and Cambodia are restoring it together.
e1jq6tfk1rl9p.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

en1qvt0nqm23.speaker: nekmax
en1qvt0nqm23.text: Its original name was “Rajavihara,” which means “the king's monastery.” They say it was also a place of learning.

eme58hwd3lq5.speaker: nekmax
eme58hwd3lq5.text: The inscription says that every year, at the spring festival, there was a procession of banners and parasols, and men and women danced.
